structural_review.notes: Triangle mode, valid GLB length, UVs and embedded 1024px base colour checked. Requested targets are approximate; actual triangle count and target deviations are reported separately, within the user-specified 3000-prop / 8000-character ceilings. Scale, pivot, topology and visual quality require separate review.

visual_review.notes: Accepted against approved reference from opposite actual GLB views: continuous slate post, grounded square base, warm enclosed lantern and roof. No cast light cone, base terrain or extra props. Approximately symmetric around Y; +Z is canonical front.
visual_review.qualification: Authoring/import QA only; native engine rendering, collisions and device performance not qualified.

import_review.notes: Real scene vertices and indices decoded; finite positions/UVs; retained embedded 1024px base colour. Uniform root transform; raw file preserved. Semantic forward and repaired geometry checked in actual rendered views.
